hero.title: Your Dynamic AI Career Roadmap, Synthesized in Real Time
hero.description: Tell AI Mentor what you want to master. It synthesizes your roadmap from your goals, level, and schedule — then guides you through every milestone, one task at a time.

howItWork.title: Bento Learning Architecture
howItWork.subtitle: A four-phase curriculum engine that rebuilds your path as you learn — so every milestone stays sharp and achievable.

step1.title: Diagnostic Profile Sync
step1.description: Your mentor maps your goals, current level, and available time into a clear learning profile — the foundation for every decision that follows.

step2.title: Real-time Curriculum Synthesis
step2.description: A four-phase curriculum is assembled and re-sequenced in real time, so the path you see always matches where you actually are.

step3.title: Sandbox Proof & Calibration
step3.description: Each milestone is proven through hands-on sandbox practice, then calibrated to close the gaps that matter most.

step4.title: Dynamic Milestone Refactoring
step4.description: Milestones refactor dynamically as you grow — your roadmap stays ambitious, but every next step remains achievable.
